content:
Apple has announced the next Apple Watch activity challenge, this time limited to users in Japan.

Apple said:

Simply complete the challenge using any fitness app that can save data to the Apple "Fitness" app, and you can unlock virtual rewards in the iPhone, Apple Watch, and Apple "Messages" app. You can also get exclusive stickers to use in "Messages", FaceTime, and more.

You can also complete the challenge through Apple Fitness+, Apple's workout service that offers various types of content and officially launched in Japan earlier this year.
